key_insight: AlgoEvo turns automated algorithm discovery from a fixed search pipeline into a self-evolving agent that can reason, adapt, and reuse execution feedback. This makes algorithm synthesis more interactive and capable of exploring beyond rigid predefined workflows.
problem_solved: Existing LLM-based algorithm discovery systems are constrained by rigid, pre-defined control flows. This limits adaptive reasoning, cross-paradigm transfer, and the ability to learn from execution feedback during the search process.
method: Uses an autonomous agent to dynamically inspect the search process and decide what to do next.
Accumulates knowledge from execution feedback instead of discarding it after each trial.
Unifies multiple algorithm-discovery steps into an interactive, self-evolving framework rather than a fixed pipeline.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, AlgoEvo could make algorithm discovery more flexible, efficient, and reusable across tasks. It may reduce manual pipeline design while improving the quality and diversity of discovered algorithms.
visual_elements: Before-vs-after diagram: rigid pipeline vs self-evolving agentic loop

paper_title: AlgoEvo: Self-Evolving Agentic Search for Automated Algorithm Discovery
paper_authors: Junhao Qiu, Qinglong Hu, Xialiang Tong, Mingxuan Yuan, Liyong Lin
